title: Delhi Police say they rescued 164 foreign nationals forced to run cyber fraud, arrest one
date_note: PTI reports the Delhi Police announcement and rescue on Thursday, 26 November.
summary: Delhi Police's Crime Branch said it rescued 164 foreign nationals, including 92 Indonesians and 72 Malaysians, whom it says were lured with job offers, had passports taken and were forced to make fraudulent investment calls to people in their home countries. PTI reports one Malaysian national was arrested and two other suspects are absconding. Police say those who refused were allegedly beaten.
plain: Delhi Police say they freed 164 people from Indonesia and Malaysia who were allegedly tricked with fake jobs and forced to run investment scams. One suspect was arrested.
exec: Police describe a cross-border investment fraud operation staffed by trafficked workers targeting people in Indonesia and Malaysia.
geo_basis: Delhi Police Crime Branch announced it; reports differ on the premises (Noida vs Dwarka), so the agency's city is used.
